VBO:0201134.summary: Retrievers were developed to find shot game and bring it back without damaging it, on land or in water. The category includes distinct breeds such as Labradors, Goldens and Curly-Coated Retrievers, with different histories and characters.
VBO:0201134.shortDescription: Retrievers include distinct breeds developed to recover game and carry it back gently on land or from water.

sources.title: AKC — Get to Know the Retriever Breeds
sources.evidence: Read introduction and member sections: retrieving game undamaged, gentle grip, land/water work, six AKC breeds; broad intelligence/personality generalizations deliberately excluded.
